modules.title: Unit 1: Modern Single Page Application Architecture & State Synchronization

items.title: Lecture Notes: React 18 Concurrent Rendering & State Models
items.content:
### CHED CMO 25 Module Learning Outcome 1
This module covers modern SPA architecture patterns, client-side state management, LocalStorage persistence layers, and React 18 hooks architecture.

Key Concepts:
1. Virtual DOM reconciliation algorithm
2. Pure functional state reducers
3. LocalStorage reactive sync hooks
4. RBAC route guarding

assignments.instructions: Implement a client-side React 18 application simulating the GABAY LMS Module. Synchronize state with `localStorage` and ensure strict RBAC access guards.

submissions.content:
Respected Prof. Zabala,

I have completed Laboratory Milestone 1 for GABAY LMS. The prototype implements:
1. React 18 + Vite with Tailwind CSS dark/light theme persistence.
2. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with instantaneous header switcher.
3. LocalStorage persistence for submissions, messages, and grades.

Link to repository: https://github.com/dmmmsu-sluc/gabay-lms-prototype

comments.text: Excellent compliance with CHED CMO 25 UI standards! High density data table is well designed. Clean monospace formatting for student IDs.
Thank you Prof. Zabala! I will address the minor contrast padding issue in Milestone 2.

submissions.content: Submitted GABAY LMS Module design specification. Includes client state sync and responsive sidebar navigation.

quizzes.title: Self-Check Diagnostic Quiz: React Context & Hooks Architecture
quizzes.instructions: Answer the following multiple-choice questions. Time limit is 15 minutes. Passing score is 80%.

questions.text: Which React hook is recommended for synchronizing non-React external storage such as localStorage with component state?
According to the GABAY Visual Design System guidelines, neon violet radial blur background glows are strictly discouraged.
What is the primary role restriction for Non-Teaching Staff (Registrar Aide) in GABAY LMS?
options: Strictly blocked from viewing individual student assignment grades and quiz submissions
Full access to student SpeedGrader evaluations
questions.correctAnswer: Strictly blocked from viewing individual student assignment grades and quiz submissions

quizzes.title: Quiz 1: DFA State Transition Tables
quizzes.instructions: Evaluates understanding of deterministic finite state machine transition functions.
